# Simon Balz

> Simon Balz is Head of Technology at Betty Bossi (Coop Group, Switzerland), a founder and tech advisor based in the Bern region. This is his personal website.

## Facts
- Role: Head of Technology at Betty Bossi since 2024
- Before: Co-founder, CPO and CEO of maatoo.io (2019 to 2024); Venture Builder and Venture Architect at Digital Innovation Lab; product management at Gemini Data (2015 to 2019); engineering and data analytics at T-Systems, Unic and LC Systems (2003 to 2015)
- Advisor to the Swiss Bitcoin start-up Relai since 2019
- The relaunch of bettybossi.ch won gold in Digital Commerce at Best of Swiss Web 2026
- Focus: digital commerce, product strategy, platform architecture, data and analytics, AI in products and companies
- Open to advisory and board mandates
- Contact: via the contact section on https://simonbalz.com/en/ or on LinkedIn
